commitments.text: One up-gradient well will be installed at the site and the sample analysis from this well will be used as an indicator of the quality of the groundwater in the area.
An elevation datum will be established and will be used to relate the water elevation differences in the monitoring and to indicate changes in groundwater flow.
Samples and groundwater elevations will be measured every three months (first week of July and October) during the operating season (April 1 to October 31).

The groundwater will be analyzed for specific conductance, total petroleum hydrocarbons, phenols, pH, major ions (Ca2+, Mg2+, NH4+, Na+, K+, Cl-, NO3-, SO4 2-), total organic carbon and dissolved heavy metals (As, Ba, Cd, Cr, Cu, Hg, Ni, Pb, and Zn).
